title: Sheet-Pan Chicken Fajitas
note: Prep 15 min · Cook 20 min · Serves 4. Everything roasts on one pan; warm the tortillas while it rests.
ingredients: 1.5 lb boneless skinless chicken breast, sliced into strips
Toppings: sour cream, shredded cheese, salsa, cilantro
instructions: Heat the oven to 425°F and line a large sheet pan with parchment.
Toss the chicken, peppers and onion with the oil, chili powder, cumin, paprika, garlic powder and salt.
Spread in a single layer and roast 18–20 minutes, stirring once, until the chicken reaches 165°F and the peppers are charred at the edges.
Squeeze the lime juice over the pan.
Warm the tortillas in a dry skillet or wrapped in foil in the oven for the last 5 minutes.
Serve family-style with the toppings.

title: Grilled Lemon-Herb Chicken Thighs
note: Prep 10 min (+30 min marinade) · Cook 15 min · Serves 4. Thighs stay juicy on the grill and the marinade doubles as a dressing.
ingredients: 1 tbsp chopped fresh rosemary or 1 tsp dried
1 tbsp chopped fresh oregano or 1 tsp dried
instructions: Whisk the oil, lemon zest and juice, garlic, herbs, salt and pepper in a bowl.
Add the chicken, turn to coat, and marinate 30 minutes (or up to 8 hours in the fridge).
Heat the grill to medium-high (about 425°F) and oil the grates.
Grill the thighs 6–7 minutes per side until charred and 165°F inside.
Rest 5 minutes, then slice and serve with rice or a green salad.

title: Turkey Burgers with Avocado
note: Prep 10 min · Cook 12 min · Serves 4. Grated onion keeps lean turkey moist.
ingredients: Lettuce, tomato and your favorite sauce
instructions: Mix the turkey, onion, garlic, Worcestershire, salt and pepper gently; shape into 4 patties slightly wider than the buns.
Press a shallow dimple into the center of each patty so they cook flat.
Heat the grill to medium-high and oil the grates (or use a skillet with the oil).
Cook 5–6 minutes per side until 165°F inside.
Toast the buns for the last minute.
Build with avocado, lettuce, tomato and sauce.

title: Honey-Soy Grilled Salmon
note: Prep 10 min · Cook 10 min · Serves 4. A four-ingredient glaze that kids like; cooks in minutes.
ingredients: 4 salmon fillets (6 oz each), skin on
Sliced green onion and sesame seeds, to finish
instructions: Stir the honey, soy sauce, vinegar, garlic and ginger together; set aside 2 tablespoons for serving.
Brush the salmon with oil and season lightly with salt.
Heat the grill to medium-high and oil the grates well.
Grill skin side down 5 minutes, brush with glaze, flip carefully and grill 3–4 minutes more until it flakes.
Spoon the reserved glaze over, top with green onion and sesame seeds, and serve with rice and steamed broccoli.

title: Chicken Burrito Bowls
note: Prep 15 min · Cook 20 min · Serves 4. Set out the toppings and let everyone build their own.
ingredients: 1.5 lb boneless skinless chicken thighs or breasts, cubed
Shredded cheese, salsa and sour cream
instructions: Cook the rice according to the package.
Toss the chicken with the oil and taco seasoning.
Sear in a hot skillet 6–8 minutes until cooked through.
Warm the beans and corn in the same skillet for 2 minutes.
Assemble bowls: rice, chicken, beans and corn, tomatoes, avocado and toppings; finish with a squeeze of lime.

title: Pasta Primavera
note: Prep 10 min · Cook 20 min · Serves 4. Whatever vegetables are in the fridge work here.
instructions: Boil the pasta in salted water; add the broccoli for the last 3 minutes. Reserve 1 cup pasta water before draining.
Meanwhile warm the oil in a large skillet and cook the garlic 30 seconds.
Add the zucchini and pepper; cook 4–5 minutes until just tender.
Add the tomatoes and peas for 2 minutes.
Toss in the pasta and broccoli with a splash of pasta water, the Parmesan and lemon zest until glossy.
Season and top with basil.

title: Crispy Baked Chicken Tenders with Honey Mustard
note: Prep 15 min · Cook 18 min · Serves 4. Panko and a hot oven give fried-style crunch without frying.
ingredients: Honey mustard: 3 tbsp mayonnaise, 2 tbsp Dijon, 2 tbsp honey
instructions: Heat the oven to 425°F; set a wire rack on a sheet pan and spray it with oil.
Mix the panko, Parmesan, paprika, garlic powder and salt in a shallow dish.
Dredge each tender in flour, then egg, then press into the panko.
Arrange on the rack, spray the tops with oil, and bake 16–18 minutes until golden and 165°F.
Stir the honey mustard ingredients together and serve for dipping.

title: Beef and Broccoli Stir-Fry
note: Prep 15 min · Cook 12 min · Serves 4. Faster than takeout; slice the beef thin while it is still cold.
ingredients: 1 lb flank steak, sliced thin against the grain
instructions: Toss the beef with the cornstarch.
Whisk the soy sauce, oyster sauce, sugar and water together.
Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a large skillet over high heat; sear the beef in one layer 2 minutes per side and remove.
Add the remaining oil, broccoli and 2 tablespoons water; cover and steam 3 minutes.
Add the garlic and ginger for 30 seconds, then the beef and sauce; simmer 1–2 minutes until glossy.
Serve over rice.

title: Garlic-Butter Grilled Shrimp Skewers
note: Prep 15 min · Cook 6 min · Serves 4. Soak wooden skewers so they do not burn.
ingredients: 1.5 lb large shrimp, peeled and deveined
1 lemon, half juiced and half in wedges
instructions: Soak wooden skewers 20 minutes in water.
Stir the butter, garlic, paprika, salt and lemon juice together.
Thread the shrimp onto the skewers and brush with half the garlic butter.
Grill over high heat 2–3 minutes per side until pink and opaque.
Brush with the remaining butter, scatter with parsley and serve with lemon wedges, rice or crusty bread.

title: Black Bean Tacos with Corn Salsa
note: Prep 15 min · Cook 10 min · Serves 4. A meatless taco night that still fills everyone up.
ingredients: Corn salsa: 1.5 cups corn, 1 cup cherry tomatoes diced, 1/4 red onion minced, 1 lime juiced, handful cilantro chopped
Shredded cheese, avocado and sour cream
instructions: Stir the corn salsa ingredients together with a pinch of salt.
Simmer the beans with the cumin, chili powder, salt and water 5 minutes, mashing some of them.
Char the tortillas over a gas flame or warm them in a dry skillet.
Fill with beans, corn salsa, cheese and avocado.

title: Skillet Pork Chops with Apples
note: Prep 10 min · Cook 20 min · Serves 4. Sweet apples and onions make a quick pan sauce.
instructions: Pat the chops dry and season with salt, pepper and thyme.
Sear in the oil over medium-high heat 4 minutes per side; remove to a plate.
Cook the apples and onion in the same pan 5 minutes until softened.
Add the broth and mustard, scrape up the browned bits, and simmer 3 minutes.
Return the chops, cover and cook 3–4 minutes until 145°F.
Swirl in the butter and serve over mashed potatoes or rice.

title: Grilled Vegetable Kebabs with Chimichurri
note: Prep 20 min · Cook 12 min · Serves 4. Colorful, meatless, and great alongside anything else on the grill.
ingredients: Chimichurri: 1 cup parsley, 2 cloves garlic, 1/4 cup olive oil, 2 tbsp red wine vinegar, 1/2 tsp red pepper flakes, salt
instructions: Pulse the chimichurri ingredients in a food processor (or chop finely) and set aside.
Toss the vegetables with the oil and salt and thread onto skewers, mixing colors.
Grill over medium-high heat 10–12 minutes, turning every few minutes, until charred and tender.
Spoon the chimichurri over and serve with couscous or flatbread.

title: Naan Margherita Pizzas
note: Prep 10 min · Cook 10 min · Serves 4. Store-bought naan makes personal pizzas in minutes.
instructions: Heat the oven to 450°F and put a sheet pan in to heat.
Spread sauce over each naan, top with mozzarella and tomatoes.
Slide onto the hot pan and bake 8–10 minutes until the cheese bubbles and the edges crisp.
Finish with basil, a drizzle of oil and pepper flakes.

title: Teriyaki Chicken Rice Bowls
note: Prep 10 min · Cook 20 min · Serves 4. Homemade teriyaki from pantry staples.
ingredients: 1.5 lb boneless skinless chicken thighs, cubed
1 tbsp cornstarch mixed with 2 tbsp water
Sesame seeds and sliced green onion
instructions: Cook the rice.
Sear the chicken in the oil over medium-high heat 6–8 minutes until browned and cooked through.
Add the soy sauce, sugar, vinegar, garlic and ginger; simmer 2 minutes.
Stir in the cornstarch slurry and cook 1 minute until thick and glossy.
Serve over rice with broccoli, sesame seeds and green onion.

title: Spaghetti with Turkey Meatballs
note: Prep 20 min · Cook 25 min · Serves 4. Baked meatballs, no splatter.
instructions: Heat the oven to 400°F and line a sheet pan with parchment.
Mix the turkey, panko, Parmesan, egg, garlic, parsley, salt and pepper; roll into 16 meatballs.
Bake 15–18 minutes until 165°F inside.
Warm the marinara in a large pot and add the meatballs to simmer 5 minutes.
Cook the spaghetti in salted water, drain, and serve under the meatballs with more Parmesan.

title: Grilled Chicken Caesar Wraps
note: Prep 10 min · Cook 12 min · Serves 4. Lunch or dinner; packs well for the next day too.
ingredients: 1.25 lb boneless skinless chicken breast, pounded even
instructions: Rub the chicken with the oil, Italian seasoning and salt.
Grill over medium-high heat 5–6 minutes per side until 165°F; rest, then slice.
Toss the romaine with the dressing, Parmesan and croutons.
Lay the salad and chicken down the center of each tortilla, fold the sides in and roll tightly. Halve to serve.

title: Shrimp Fried Rice
note: Prep 10 min · Cook 15 min · Serves 4. Best with day-old rice, which fries instead of steaming.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a large skillet or wok over high heat; cook the shrimp 2 minutes per side and remove.
Scramble the eggs in the pan, then push to the side.
Add the remaining oil, garlic, peas and carrots; stir-fry 1 minute.
Add the rice, pressing it into the pan, and let it crisp 2 minutes before stirring.
Return the shrimp, add the soy sauce, sesame oil and green onions, and toss to combine.

title: Greek Chicken Pitas with Tzatziki
note: Prep 15 min · Cook 12 min · Serves 4. Grilled chicken, cool yogurt sauce, warm pita.
ingredients: Tzatziki: 1 cup Greek yogurt, 1/2 cucumber grated and squeezed dry, 1 clove garlic minced, 1 tbsp lemon juice, 1 tbsp chopped dill, salt
Sliced tomato, cucumber and red onion
instructions: Toss the chicken with the oil, lemon juice, oregano, garlic and salt; marinate 15 minutes while you make the tzatziki.
Stir the tzatziki ingredients together and chill.
Grill the chicken over medium-high heat 5–6 minutes per side until 165°F; rest and slice.
Warm the pitas on the grill 30 seconds per side.
Stuff with chicken, vegetables and a generous spoon of tzatziki.

title: Lemon-Dill Baked Salmon with Roasted Potatoes
note: Prep 10 min · Cook 25 min · Serves 4. One oven, two pans, dinner done.
ingredients: 1 lemon, sliced, plus juice of another
instructions: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the potatoes with 2 tablespoons oil, half the salt and pepper; roast 15 minutes.
Rub the salmon with the remaining oil, garlic, lemon juice, dill, salt and pepper; top with lemon slices.
Push the potatoes to one side, add the asparagus and the salmon to the pan.
Roast 10–12 minutes more until the salmon flakes and the potatoes are golden.

title: Grilled Steak Tacos with Pico de Gallo
note: Prep 20 min · Cook 10 min · Serves 4. Skirt or flank steak, quick marinade, high heat.
ingredients: Pico de gallo: 3 Roma tomatoes diced, 1/4 white onion minced, 1 jalapeño minced, handful cilantro, 1 lime juiced, salt
instructions: Rub the steak with the oil, lime juice, garlic, cumin, chili powder and salt; marinate 15 minutes.
Mix the pico de gallo and let it sit.
Grill the steak over high heat 3–4 minutes per side for medium-rare; rest 5 minutes and slice thin against the grain.
Warm the tortillas on the grill.
Fill with steak, pico and cheese.

title: Tomato Basil Soup with Grilled Cheese
note: Prep 10 min · Cook 25 min · Serves 4. The classic pairing; the soup freezes well.
ingredients: Grilled cheese: 8 slices bread, 8 slices cheddar, 3 tbsp butter
instructions: Melt the butter and soften the onion 5 minutes; add the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, broth and sugar; simmer 15 minutes.
Blend until smooth (an immersion blender is easiest), stir in the cream and basil, and season.
Butter the bread, fill with cheese, and cook in a skillet over medium heat 3 minutes per side until golden.
Serve the sandwiches cut in triangles for dunking.

title: Chicken and Veggie Quesadillas
note: Prep 10 min · Cook 15 min · Serves 4. Uses leftover or rotisserie chicken.
ingredients: 2 cups shredded Monterey Jack or cheddar
instructions: Toss the chicken with the taco seasoning.
Sprinkle half of each tortilla with cheese, chicken, pepper and corn, then a little more cheese; fold over.
Cook in a buttered skillet over medium heat 3 minutes per side until crisp and the cheese melts.
Cut into wedges and serve with salsa and sour cream.

title: Grilled BBQ Chicken Drumsticks
note: Prep 10 min · Cook 30 min · Serves 4. Low and slow over indirect heat, sauce at the end so it does not burn.
instructions: Pat the drumsticks dry and rub with the oil, sugar, paprika, garlic powder, salt and pepper.
Set the grill up for two-zone cooking: one side on medium, the other off.
Grill over the lit side 2 minutes per side to brown, then move to the cool side, cover and cook 20–25 minutes, turning twice, until 175°F.
Brush with barbecue sauce and grill over direct heat 2 minutes per side to glaze.
Serve with corn on the cob and coleslaw.

title: Weeknight Turkey Chili
note: Prep 10 min · Cook 30 min · Serves 6. Mild enough for kids; add hot sauce at the table.
ingredients: 2 (15 oz) cans beans (kidney and black), rinsed
Toppings: shredded cheese, sour cream, green onion, tortilla chips
instructions: Soften the onion and pepper in the oil 5 minutes; add the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the turkey and cook, breaking it up, until no longer pink.
Stir in the chili powder, cumin and paprika for 30 seconds.
Add the tomatoes, beans, broth and salt; simmer uncovered 20 minutes.
Serve with the toppings.

title: Veggie Egg Scramble (Breakfast for Dinner)
note: Prep 10 min · Cook 10 min · Serves 4. Toast and fruit on the side and dinner is done.
ingredients: Toast or warm tortillas, for serving
instructions: Whisk the eggs with the milk and salt.
Melt the butter in a nonstick skillet over medium heat; wilt the spinach and warm the tomatoes 2 minutes.
Pour in the eggs and stir slowly with a spatula until softly set.
Fold in the cheese and green onions and serve right away with toast.

title: Grilled Corn and Avocado Chicken Salad
note: Prep 15 min · Cook 15 min · Serves 4. A summer main-course salad that uses the grill for everything.
ingredients: 6 cups chopped romaine or mixed greens
Dressing: 3 tbsp olive oil, 2 tbsp lime juice, 1 tsp honey, pinch of cumin, salt
instructions: Rub the chicken and corn with the oil, salt and pepper.
Grill the chicken over medium-high heat 5–6 minutes per side until 165°F; grill the corn alongside, turning, until charred.
Rest the chicken, then slice; cut the kernels off the cobs.
Whisk the dressing.
Toss the greens, corn, avocado, tomatoes, onion and feta with the dressing and top with the chicken.
